title: nextflow-io/hello pipeline parameters
description: A simple Hello World pipeline for Nextflow

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input files.

input.description: Path to a directory containing input files, one greeting per file.
input.help_text: Accepts a local path or a remote path such as an S3 URI, e.g. 's3://my-bucket/hello-input/'. Each file found is read and its contents used as the greeting text. If not provided, the pipeline falls back to its built-in demo greetings.
